title: The Vault's Stone
journal: The second seal-stone lies in the lowest hall of the Vaults of Gemin, which is under water. The dead walk the vaults and a wraith guards the last hall, and Unbound may be searching there. I'm to go down and take it. I can fight through, slip past them, or turn the dead with Restoration.
objectives: Take the seal-stone from the drowned lowest hall of Gemin. (marker: Seal-Stone of the Kings, Gemin)
Read the Tablet of the Kings beside the stone. (marker: Tablet of the Kings)

plan.going: I am hunting the three seal-stones for the Toh-Reel-Ka; this one is in Gemin's drowned lowest hall
plan.next: go down through the vaults to the lowest hall and take the stone; read the tablet beside it
plan.ways: fight the Unbound, the dead and the wraith; slip past them (Sneak); turn the dead and the wraith (Restoration); I must swim the last hall, or carry waterbreathing

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka as a Reel-Ka. I already hold the first Seal-Stone of the Kings. The second lies in the flooded Vaults of Gemin. All three stones open the gate at Teku-Sul Spire, which leads to the Eye at the Root. The Unbound and the Collector are also hunting relics.
Go down through the vaults to the drowned lowest hall, take the Seal-Stone and read the Tablet of the Kings beside it.
I can fight through the dead, sneak past them, or turn the dead with Restoration. There is a Warden of the Vaults, an Unbound Rearguard and Restless Dead here, so I could also talk to them.
I do not know why the Unbound seal trees they drain, what the Tablet says, or how the wraith guard behaves. I could find out by reading the Tablet and talking to people.

title: The Vault's Stone
journal: I took the second seal-stone from the drowned hall of Gemin. The tablet beside it says that the Eye, lifted, parts every tree from every other, and used where it sits, it strengthens them. I already carry the thief's stone from Blackrose. One is left, in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and it is still marked.

answers: I took the second Seal-Stone from Gemin. The tablet says the Eye, if lifted, parts every tree from every other, and if used where it sits, strengthens them. I hold two stones now; the Toh-Reel-Ka want all three.
Get the third stone from the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, with a boat near Noota Nara, then take all three to the gate at Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth.
I can go to Vorannuhl by boat. After that I choose whether to open the gate. The tablet suggests the Eye can be used in two opposed ways, so I should think about that choice.
I do not understand why the Unbound drain trees, what the Fort Chalkmoth cellar holds, or how Nesh-Deeka knows about the Unbound. I could ask people about these.
